note: The day Joshua died (according to tradition, see Joshua 24:29). “It came about after these things that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being one hundred and ten years old.” Yom HaShoah, Israel's Holocaust Memorial Day: In Israel, sirens sound at 10:00 a.m. Most of the country and traffic come to a complete stop, observing 2 minutes of standing silence to remember those who died. Day 12 of the Omer
prompts: What verse spoke to you most today and why?
Did you learn something about God?
